description: This Java source file defines a singleton class that provides mapping strategies from specific signal response types to JsonifiableMapper instances for handling thing query command responses within the Eclipse Ditto protocol adapter. It includes methods for initializing a map of response type identifiers to corresponding lambda functions that create response objects from adaptable JSON signals.

classes.name: ThingQueryCommandResponseMappingStrategies
classes.description: A singleton class that provides a set of mapping strategies from various thing query response types to corresponding JsonifiableMapper instances, used for deserializing JSON signals into typed response objects.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of this mapping strategies class.

methods.name: initMappingStrategies
methods.description: Initializes and returns the map of response type strings to JsonifiableMapper functions for each response type.

methods.name: thingsArrayFrom
methods.description: Extracts a JsonArray of things from an Adaptable payload, throwing a JsonParseException if the payload is not an array.
